title: Metizolam

attribution.author: Josie Kins

notes.overview: Effects vary widely by individual, dose, and context.

effects.name: Emotion suppression
effects.description: Although this compound primarily suppresses anxiety, it also dulls other emotions in a manner which is distinct but less intensive than that of antipsychotics.

effects.name: Delusions of sobriety
effects.description: This is the false belief that one is perfectly sober despite obvious evidence to the contrary such as severe cognitive impairment and an inability to fully communicate with others. It most commonly occurs at heavy dosages.
